value.rationale: A natural minimal equal-dose radiotherapy timing benchmark has exact interior asymmetry transitions despite symmetric endpoints, quantified sharp critical ratios, a square-root bifurcation, and an explicit minimum-gap adjustment. This structural map is nontrivial for competing tissue repair clocks and makes an interpretable analytic complement to numerical clinical fractionation optimization; no unsupported clinical benefit is claimed.
